bib.title: Audiobox: Unified Audio Generation with Natural Language Prompts

question: Can one flow-matching model generate speech and sound from text descriptions, audio examples, or both, with finer control than modality-specific models?
hypothesis: Self-supervised infilling pre-training on large mixed speech/music/sound data, then fine-tuning, yields a unified model that matches or beats modality-specific models.
contributions: Audiobox SSL: flow-matching infilling pre-training on 160K h speech, 20K h music, 6K h sound
Audiobox Speech and Audiobox Sound fine-tuned from it
Unified Audiobox with description-based and example-based (voice prompt) control
Bespoke Solver integration giving 25x fewer ODE evaluations

method.summary: A 330M-parameter Transformer trained with conditional flow matching on Encodec dense latents, pre-trained by masked-frame infilling on unlabeled audio, then fine-tuned for transcript-guided speech, caption-guided sound, and a unified model taking transcript, description, voice prompt and audio context. Inference uses an ODE solver (midpoint or dopri5; Bespoke solver for 4 steps) with classifier-free guidance and CLAP re-ranking.
method.task: audio generation: in-context TTS, description-guided TTS, text-to-audio, infilling

datasets.name: Mix-185K (SSL pre-training)
datasets.size: over 160K hours speech, 20K hours music, 6K hours sound
datasets.source: internal mix: audiobooks, podcasts, read sentences, talks, conversations, in-the-wild; speakers from over 150 countries, over 200 primary languages
datasets.preprocessing: samples randomly chunked if over 1,600 frames

datasets.name: SP-multi-100K
datasets.preprocessing: PyAnnote diarization for unsegmented conversations; Whisper large-v2 and medium.en transcription; drop if P(English)<50% or WER between the two transcripts >50%; inverse text normalization with Whisper-punctuator

datasets.name: SD-tag-6K
datasets.preprocessing: tags at different ontology levels concatenated as pseudo-caption

datasets.name: Speech captions (automatic + human)
datasets.size: 500 hour human-annotated subset of SP-multi-100K; the rest LLM captions from attribute tags; stage 2 about 2,310 hours total
datasets.source: Llama 2 7B converts attributes (age 4 classes, gender 2, quality 3, pitch 3, rate 3, accent/emotion/environment open vocabulary) into captions using a style bank; RIR and background noise augmentation
datasets.preprocessing: quality set to low when noise added

datasets.name: AudioCaps test
datasets.preprocessing: TTA and text-guided infilling (30% context, middle 70% infilled)

datasets.name: Accent (internal)
datasets.source: internal expressive accented read sentences, 10 emotions

datasets.name: SpCap (SC)
datasets.source: annotated samples from LibriTTS, Common Voice, Switchboard, Fisher, Spotify, AudioSet, Expresso

datasets.name: AC-filt
datasets.source: AudioCaps test with reliable ASR transcripts (Lee et al. 2023)

datasets.name: Accent+
datasets.source: Accent set with random RIR and noise augmentation

models.name: Audiobox SSL
models.architecture: Transformer, conv position embeddings, symmetric bi-directional ALiBi, UNet skip connections, flow matching on Encodec dense features

models.name: Audiobox Speech
models.architecture: Audiobox SSL + char embeddings (128 dim) frame-aligned by SeamlessM4T v2 aligner; full fine-tuning

models.name: Audiobox Sound
models.architecture: Audiobox SSL + T5-base text encoder, cross-attention in every layer (16 heads)

models.name: Audiobox (unified)
models.architecture: Audiobox SSL + frozen T5-base (512 dim, linear to 1024) + 3-layer voice-prompt Transformer (1024, 16 heads, FFN 4096) + cross-attention

models.name: Unified duration model
models.architecture: 12 Transformer decoder layers with cross-attention to description

models.name: Joint-CLAP (Speech-CLAP)
models.architecture: WavLM-base+ audio encoder, RoBERTa-base text encoder, contrastive loss

models.name: AudioLDM2 / AudioLDM / TANGO / UniAudio / Voicebox / VALL-E / NS2 / YourTTS

other.note: baselines evaluated from official repos; VALL-E, NS2, UniAudio numbers cited from prior work

training.objective: conditional flow matching (OT path), loss on masked frames only; contrastive CLAP loss for Joint-CLAP
training.batch_size: 480K frames effective (SSL); 240K frames (Speech); 720K (Sound stage 1), 240K (stage 2); 75 per GPU x 64 GPUs (Joint-CLAP)
training.steps: SSL 1M updates; Speech 200K; Speech duration 600K; Sound 200K then 100K; Audiobox stage 1 max 600K (stopped at 350K), stage 2 100K LoRA r=64; unified duration 600K (eval 200K ckpt); Joint-CLAP 200K
training.precision: Joint-CLAP: raw floating point, no quantization
training.dropout: Audiobox: P(vp=F)=0.5, P(ctx=F|vp=T)=0.7, P(ctx=F|vp=F)=0.5, P(cap=F)=0.3; Speech: audio fully masked p=0.3; duration fully masked 0.2
training.hardware: Audiobox stage 1: 32 A100-80GB; stage 2: 16 A100-80GB; unified duration: 8 A100-80GB; Joint-CLAP: 64 Volta32

other.joint_probs: ZS-TTS 0.075, desc-TTS w/ vocal 0.245, desc-TTS 0.175, sampling 0.075

inference.decoding: ODE solver via torchdiffeq: midpoint step 0.0625 (32 NFE, 64 model calls with CFG) for Audiobox Speech; step 1/32 (64 NFE, 128 calls) for unified; dopri5 tol 1e-5 for Sound
inference.samples: Sound: 32 samples per prompt, best by CLAP; Audiobox desc-TTS: N=8 with stochastic silence padding, CLAP rerank; sound-only N=16; duration averaged over 5 samples
inference.prompting: 3 s audio prompt (trailing silence removed); description via T5

parameters.cfg_weight: 0.7 Speech; 1 Sound (tuned 0 to 5); 0.75 desc-TTS; 1.33 sound-only; 1.0 ZS-TTS
parameters.silence_padding: random 0 to 3 s both ends for desc-TTS
parameters.bespoke: ground truth paths from dopri5, N=200 steps, GW 0.7; 4 steps = 8 NFE

metrics.name: Sim-o / Sim-r
metrics.definition: cosine similarity of WavLM-TDCNN embeddings between prompt and generated audio (original / resynthesized prompt)

metrics.name: CLAP / JointCLAP
metrics.definition: cosine of text and audio embeddings

metrics.name: MOS (style similarity, quality QMOS, OVL, REL)
metrics.definition: 1 to 5 ratings, 5 annotators per sample from professional service, 100 AudioCaps files

eval.protocol: Objective metrics plus professional-rater MOS; 95% confidence intervals; no seeds or significance tests stated

availability.data: demo at audiobox.metademolab.com; training data internal

limits: Description-based control is limited by scarce paired audio-description data; unseen concepts (chihuahua vs dog, regional accents) cannot be generated (Sec 10.1)
Fine-grained descriptions are hard to create and annotators disagree on emotion, age, quality (Sec 10.1)
Most speech captions are LLM-generated from coarse tags; only 500 hours are human-annotated
No statistical significance tests or seeds; training data and weights not released; code not stated
Unified model slightly worse WER than Audiobox Speech (e.g. avg 4.8 vs 4.0) and worse FAD than Audiobox Sound
Mostly English; baselines VoiceLDM/AudioLDM2 fed averaged CLAP embeddings for voice+description, a best-effort comparison
Fairness tested only on zero-shot TTS; watermarking depends on Seamless Watermark
